SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(guarantee_amount), 0) AS guarantee_amount, COALESCE(SUM(premium_amount), 0) AS premium_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT enterprise_id) AS enterprise_count, COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) AS project_count FROM (
SELECT enterprise_id, project_id, guarantee_amount, premium_amount FROM tender_order WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT enterprise_id, project_id, guarantee_amount, premium_amount FROM performance_order WHERE 1 = 1
) merged
